tools.name: opensay_get_install_link
tools.description: Returns the official 1-click Add to Slack OAuth installation link for OpenSay (requires human Slack Workspace Admin approval), Slack App Directory listing, 7-day free Business trial details, and onboarding steps.

tools.name: opensay_estimate_pricing
tools.description: Calculates exact OpenSay for Slack Business (flat workspace tiers up to 1,000 members) or Enterprise (1,001+ members) pricing, annual savings (2 months free), Freemium tier, and 7-day free Business trial terms.

tools.name: opensay_get_compliance_and_security
tools.description: Retrieves OpenSay cryptographic anonymity architecture (one-way nonce-salted SHA-256 with rotating secret peppers), regulatory alignment (EU Whistleblower Directive 2019/1937, US SOX § 301, ISO 37002, GDPR), AI moderation guardrails, and links to DPA, Security, Permission Scopes, and Subprocessors.

tools.name: opensay_draft_workflow_plan
tools.description: Generates a tailored rollout plan, recommended Slack channel configuration, dashboard checklist, and ready-to-post team announcement for an OpenSay use case.

tools.name: opensay_get_workspace_status
tools.description: Fetches high-level workspace status (plan, 7-day trial status, member count, whitelist/whisper/AI moderation flags) for an authenticated Slack or OpenSay Admin. Never returns user identities or message-to-user mappings.

tools.name: opensay_create_pulse_survey
tools.description: Drafts (dryRun=true by default) or dispatches a confidential 1-on-1 Slack DM pulse survey to the workspace or a specific Slack usergroup. Responses remain anonymous with aggregated score distributions in app.opensay.co.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "opensay_get_compliance_and_security" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: opensay_get_workspace_status · Private data: opensay_get_compliance_and_security · Public sink: opensay_draft_workflow_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: opensay_get_workspace_status · Private data: opensay_get_compliance_and_security · Public sink: opensay_draft_workflow_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
